# E0147: a version file imports a package its Schema does not use

A version file's imports serve its Schema. A lens calls the strings functions
without an import, so an import the Schema does not use has no purpose.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
import "strings"

Schema: {
	name:  string
	label: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		label: strings.ToUpper(v0_0.name)
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0147]: 1.0.thema imports strings, which its Schema does not use
 --> 1.0.thema:1:8
  |
1 | import "strings"
  |        ^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: remove the import: a lens calls the strings functions without one
```
